thread:
nina: quick note — spotted that the Go quickstart README uses the old Client.Do(...) retry API. that signature was removed in go-sdk v0.9 and folks are hitting compile errors when they paste it.

rahul: thanks for flagging. which file? examples/go-quickstart/README.md?

nina: yeah. current snippet:```go
client := redwood.NewClient("sk-xxx")
resp, err := client.Do(context.Background(), &redwood.Request{Prompt: "Hi"})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

nina: should be updated to show the new API and context cancel patterns and how to set retry policy:```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
defer cancel()
client := redwood.NewClientFromEnv() // picks up REDWOOD_API_KEY or default creds
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, redwood.GenerateParams{Prompt: "Hello"}, redwood.WithRetry(redwood.Retry{MaxAttempts: 3}))
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

phil_docs: good catch. we should also call out that the SDK default retry uses exponential backoff and 429/5xx rules, so people understand why requests might be retried. add a tiny troubleshooting note about context deadlines to prevent runaway processes.

rahul: i'll open a PR to swap the snippet and add a unit smoke test that compiles the example with `go test` against a local mock. also adding a docs-lint pattern that flags `NewClient("sk-`) inline keys and `client.Do(` invocations.

build-bot: CI triggered for PR #312 — running go-example-compile, docs-lint, and examples-smoke.

qa-tech: when adding the mock, please include a test for the retry behavior: verify that the client retries on 500 and honors MaxAttempts. recorded mocks are ok for control but prefer small in-memory handler for stability.

rahul: added tests and a tiny mock handler. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/312 — replaces snippet, adds docs note about retries, and adds `examples/go-quickstart/main_test.go`.

phil_docs: I'll review. also let's add a short blurb to CONTRIBUTING.md recommending maintainers run `go test ./examples/...` before merging.

nina: thanks — this should cut down on confusing compile errors new Go users hit. anyone see similar issues in other langs?

rahul: scanning Ruby and PHP next week. will post any findings.

build-bot: PR #312 passed docs-lint and go-example-compile. deploy preview available: https://deploy.previews.redwood-inference/examples/312

phil_docs: merging after tiny wording tweak. thanks for the quick turnaround :tada:
